title: NYC 311 service requests
license: NYC Open Data terms of use
cohort: January 2025 requests with unique key divisible by 17. Status and closure fields reflect the export, not historical status on February 1.
transformations: Local source dates interpreted in America/New_York, including DST for closures outside January. Created day retains the local calendar date. Closure duration and age at the fixed reference date are derived; negative closure durations are null.
